_doc: Policy for .claude/hooks/guard.py (AGENTS.md > Deterministic gates). Generated by scripts/quality/guard_policy.py: edit the rules there, not here; the gate checks the two agree. The worked examples below are data kept here, replayed by test_guard.py: add one whenever the policy changes. Globs without '/' match the basename; with '/' the repo-relative path ('*' crosses '/'). guard.py, guard_base.py and test_guard.py are identical across the owner's Full-tier repositories; only this file differs.

funds_patterns.reason: enters the previous rikurinode checkout, where the LIVE node runs — this repository only reads it by absolute path or git -C … log/show/diff/grep. The owner decides
runs a program in or from the previous rikurinode checkout, where the LIVE node runs. The owner decides
git command that changes the previous rikurinode checkout (only log/show/diff/grep and other reads are free; a -c option can run a program)
writes, edits, moves or deletes files in the previous rikurinode checkout or its parent folder, where the LIVE node runs. The owner decides

names the previous rikurinode checkout, or anything in its parent folder, where the LIVE node runs, in a command that is not one of the reads this repository allows there (cat, less, head, tail, grep, ls, diff, find without -delete or -exec, sed -n, git -C … log/show/diff, …) or a copy out of it. The owner decides
starts, stops, removes, copies or enters a container — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides (its containers: bitcoin, lnd, tor, …); this repository never runs containers here
drives the container runtime directly (its socket, ctr, runc, nsenter) — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides
changes a service or the machine's power state (systemctl, loginctl, reboot, init) — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides
changes the host's system packages — on this machine the LIVE node's host (a Linux update deadlocked the node, 2026-10-09). The owner decides
kills node daemons, the container runtime, or processes found by name or PID 1 — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides
lncli command that moves funds, changes channels or credentials, or stops LND — owner approves
lncli command that funds, signs or broadcasts a transaction, or changes a channel — owner approves
bitcoin-cli command that spends, exposes keys, or changes the node's chain or network state — owner approves
prints private keys, or reads its arguments where the guard cannot see them (-stdin) — owner approves
stops LND — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides
stops bitcoind — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides
tapcli asset send/mint/burn — owner approves
deletes wallet / channel / chain data — owner approves
a write to LND's (or Loop's, Pool's, Taproot Assets') API — payments, channels, on-chain sends, keys — owner approves
names one of the node's key files (wallet, macaroons, channel backup, onion key, seed) — its contents must not leave the node; the owner decides
hands a macaroon (an LND credential) to a command — owner approves
Lightning Loop or Pool operation that moves funds — owner approves
feeds commands to a node CLI that the guard cannot see one by one — owner approves
copies or archives the node's wallet, key or channel folders — owner approves

names a node or container tool (lncli, bitcoin-cli, tapcli, litcli, chantools, docker, podman, nerdctl, docker-compose, podman-compose) in a command that is not one of the reads this repository allows — this machine runs the LIVE mainnet node. The owner decides

a node, container or system command broken across lines inside program code (a backslash at a quoted line's end, or the escapes \\ and \n), or started on a new line there by a \n escape: the program, not the shell, reads it, so the guard cannot judge it whole. Write it on one line of its own
a command continued onto the next line (backslash-newline): the previous guard, which runs beside guard.py, judges each line on its own (verifier, 2026-10-10). Join it onto one line
a `>|` redirection (it overwrites even under noclobber): the shared guard.py splits a command at every `|`, so it cannot see where this one writes. Write `>` instead, or the owner approves
turns off or rewrites the pre-commit gate (the secret scan and the hygiene check) — a gate is never switched off to get through (Law 2); the owner decides
copies into scripts/quality, the folder that holds the pre-commit hook (a protected path) — the owner decides
gh pr merge lands work on a protected branch on GitHub — owner approves
changes or deletes the GitHub repository itself — owner approves
deletes or archives the GitHub repository — irreversible; owner approves
a gh api write changes GitHub state directly (branch protection, rulesets, workflows, secrets, merges, refs) — owner approves
a GraphQL mutation, or a GraphQL body the guard cannot read (file, --input, shell variable), may change GitHub state — owner approves
disables a CI workflow — a required gate is never switched off to get green (Law 2); owner approves
changes GitHub Actions secrets or variables — owner approves
prints a GitHub credential into the transcript (gh auth token, gh auth status --show-token) — owner approves
rewrites repository history — owner approves
